summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 13, 2026. The meeting will consider election of Class II directors, adoption of a 2026 Employee Share Incentive Plan, and a special resolution to reduce the par value of shares from US$0.0001 to US$0.0000001 while restructuring authorized share capital. This is a routine corporate governance filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign terms disclosed. The filing serves only to convene an annual meeting and proposes no extraordinary event beyond a capital reorganization supporting an equity incentive plan. No risk-arb angle or special-situation catalyst is present.
